title: Old Lantern Quarter
recommendation: Wander a compact district of preserved merchant houses, tiled courtyards and small artisan studios. Visit in the morning for softer light and quieter lanes.
why_it_fits: You like heritage streets and handmade design.
tip: Ask a studio before photographing makers at work.

title: Spice Wharf Breakfast
recommendation: Try a tasting walk through family-run stalls serving saffron buns, coconut stew and seasonal fruit. Go early while breakfast counters are busy.
why_it_fits: You enjoy regional food and lively markets.
tip: Carry small cash and ask vendors about ingredients if you have dietary needs.

title: Tideglass Promenade
recommendation: Follow the flat coastal path past tide pools and shaded benches. It is especially peaceful around sunrise and offers open sea views.
why_it_fits: You want nature with an unhurried pace.
tip: Stay on marked paths and avoid slippery rocks at high tide.

title: Aurelia Maritime Museum
recommendation: Explore model boats, navigation tools and short exhibits about the bay's fishing communities. The displays make a good rainy-day stop.
why_it_fits: You enjoy local history and accessible indoor activities.
tip: Check the museum's current schedule before visiting.

title: Cedar Hill Lookout
recommendation: Take the signed uphill trail through cedar woodland to a broad viewpoint over the harbour. Allow time for the return descent.
why_it_fits: You enjoy outdoor activity and scenic viewpoints.
tip: Bring water, wear shoes with grip and return before dusk.

title: Mosaic Courtyard
recommendation: See a public courtyard decorated with ceramic panels by local artists, then browse nearby craft workshops.
why_it_fits: You enjoy public art and neighbourhood heritage.
tip: The courtyard is a shared space; keep noise low.

title: Blue Net Kayak Co-op
recommendation: Join a guided beginner paddle through sheltered inlet channels with a local cooperative. Conditions vary with wind and tide.
why_it_fits: You want active time on the water and coastal wildlife.
tip: Book with a qualified guide and wear the supplied flotation aid.

title: Juniper Table
recommendation: A small seasonal kitchen serves vegetable-forward coastal plates and fresh herb drinks in a leafy courtyard.
why_it_fits: You enjoy relaxed meals and locally sourced ingredients.
tip: Ask about daily dishes and allergens before ordering.

title: Paper & Pine Workshop
recommendation: Try a short paper-marbling or block-printing session led by neighbourhood craftspeople. Suitable for curious beginners.
tip: Reserve a place ahead for small-group sessions.

title: Quietwater Botanical Garden
recommendation: Stroll through themed native-plant beds, a butterfly garden and shaded lawns with plenty of places to pause.
why_it_fits: You prefer calm outdoor spaces and gentle family outings.
tip: Stay on paths and do not feed the wildlife.

title: Night of Small Stages
recommendation: Look for an evening programme of local acoustic music and pop-up food counters in a converted warehouse courtyard.
why_it_fits: You like live culture with informal local food.
tip: The programme changes; check the event listing on the day.

title: Saltwind Cycling Loop
recommendation: A signed, mostly level route links the fishing pier, salt marsh boardwalk and lighthouse lane. Bike hire is available from local operators.
why_it_fits: You like exploring at your own pace outdoors.
tip: Use lights, follow road rules and check wind conditions.
